pairs: Now king David had become elderly,
and he had many days in his lifetime.
And though he was covered with clothes,
Therefore, his servants said to him:
Quæramus domino nostro regi adolescentulam virginem,
“Let us seek, for our lord the king, a young virgin.
et stet coram rege, et foveat eum,
And let her stand before the king, and warm him,
and provide warmth for our lord the king.”
Quæsierunt igitur adolescentulam speciosam in omnibus finibus Israël,
And so they sought a beautiful young woman in all the parts of Israel.
And they found Abishag, a Shunammite,
and they led her to the king.
Now the girl was exceedingly beautiful.
And she slept with the king,
Yet truly, the king did not know her.
Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, exalted himself,
Fecitque sibi currus et equites, et quinquaginta viros qui currerent ante eum.
And he appointed for himself chariots and horsemen, with fifty men who would run before him.
Nec corripuit eum pater suus aliquando,
Neither did his father chastise him at any time,
Erat autem et ipse pulcher valde,
Now he, too, was very beautiful,
the second in birth, after Absalom.
Et sermo ei cum Joab filio Sarviæ,
And he conferred with Joab, the son of Zeruiah,
who gave assistance to the side of Adonijah.
and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada,
et robur exercitus David, non erat cum Adonia.
and the mature men of the army of David were not with Adonijah.
having immolated rams and calves and every kind of fat cattle beside the Stone of the Serpent,
which was in the vicinity of the fountain Rogel,
vocavit universos fratres suos filios regis,
and all the men of Judah,
et omnes viros Juda servos regis.
But he did not summon Nathan,
et Salomonem fratrem suum non vocavit.
and all the mature men, and Solomon, his brother.
Dixit itaque Nathan ad Bethsabee matrem Salomonis:
And so Nathan said to Bathsheba, the mother of Solomon:
Num audisti quod regnaverit Adonias filius Haggith,
“Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has begun to reign,
et dominus noster David hoc ignorat?
and that our lord David is ignorant of this?
and save your life and the life of your son Solomon.
Go and enter to king David,
Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me,
“Your son Solomon shall reign after me,
et ipse sedebit in solio meo?
and he himself shall sit on my throne?”
Et adhuc ibi te loquente cum rege,
And while you are still speaking with the king there,
and I will complete your words.”
Ingressa est itaque Bethsabee ad regem in cubiculum:
And so Bathsheba entered to the king in the bedroom.
Now the king was very old, and Abishag,
the Shunammite, was ministering to him.
Inclinavit se Bethsabee, et adoravit regem.
Bathsheba bowed herself, and she reverenced the king.
And the king said to her,
tu jurasti per Dominum Deum tuum ancillæ tuæ:
you swore to your handmaid, by the Lord your God:
Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me,
‘your son Solomon will reign after me,
et ipse sedebit in solio meo.
and he himself shall sit upon my throne.’
while you, my lord the king,
et pinguia quæque, et arietes plurimos,
and every kind of fattened cattle, and many rams.
And he has summoned all the sons of the king,
as well as Abiathar, the priest,
and Joab, the leader of the military.
Salomonem autem servum tuum non vocavit.
But Solomon, your servant, he did not summon.
in te oculi respiciunt totius Israël,
the eyes of all of Israel look with favor upon you,
ut indices eis quis sedere debeat in solio tuo,
that you may indicate to them who ought to sit upon your throne,
cum dormierit dominus meus rex cum patribus suis,
when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers,
I and my son Solomon will be as sinners.”
And while she was still speaking with the king,
And they announced to the king, saying,
And when he had entered in the sight of the king,
et adorasset eum pronus in terram,
and he had reverenced prone on the ground,
et ipse sedeat super thronum meum?
and let him sit upon my throne?’
and fattened cattle, and many rams.
et vocavit universos filios regis et principes exercitus,
And he summoned all the sons of the king, and the leaders of the army,
illisque vescentibus et bibentibus coram eo,
And they are eating and drinking before him,
me servum tuum, et Sadoc sacerdotem,
But he did not summon me, your servant,
and Zadok, the priest, and Benaiah,
et Salomonem famulum tuum non vocavit.
the son of Jehoiada, and Solomon, your lowly servant.
Numquid a domino meo rege exivit hoc verbum,
Could this word have gone out from my lord the king,
et mihi non indicasti servo tuo quis sessurus esset super thronum domini mei regis post eum?
and could you not have revealed it to me, your servant, as to who would be seated upon the throne of my lord the king after him?”
Quæ cum fuisset ingressa coram rege,
And when she had entered before the king,
and she had stood before him,
qui eruit animam meam de omni angustia,
who has rescued my soul from all distress,
quia sicut juravi tibi per Dominum Deum Israël,
just as I swore to you by the Lord God of Israel,
Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me,
‘Your son Solomon shall reign after me,
et ipse sedebit super solium meum pro me:
and he himself shall sit upon my throne in my place,’
so shall I do this day.”
And Bathsheba, having lowered her face to the ground,
Vivat dominus meus David in æternum.
and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada.”
Qui cum ingressi fuissent coram rege,
And when they had entered before the king,
“Take with you the servants of your lord,
et imponite Salomonem filium meum super mulam meam,
and place my son Solomon upon my mule.
Et ungat eum ibi Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta in regem super Israël: et canetis buccina, atque dicetis: Vivat rex Salomon.
And let Zadok, the priest, and Nathan, the prophet, anoint him in that place as the king over Israel. And you shall sound the trumpet, and you shall say, ‘As king Solomon lives.’
And you shall ascend after him,
et veniet, et sedebit super solium meum,
and he shall arrive and shall sit upon my throne.
And he himself shall reign in my place.
illique præcipiam ut sit dux super Israël et super Judam.
And I will command that he be the ruler over Israel and over Judah.”
Et respondit Banaias filius Jojadæ regi,
And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, responded to the king,
sic loquatur Dominus Deus domini mei regis.
So says the Lord, the God of my lord the king.
Quomodo fuit Dominus cum domino meo rege,
In the same way that the Lord has been with my lord the king,
so may he be with Solomon.
et sublimius faciat solium ejus a solio domini mei regis David.
And may he make his throne more sublime than the throne of my lord, king David.”
Then Zadok, the priest, and Nathan,
with Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada,
et imposuerunt Salomonem super mulam regis David,
And they placed Solomon on the mule of king David,
and they led him to Gihon.
Sumpsitque Sadoc sacerdos cornu olei de tabernaculo,
And Zadok, the priest, took the horn of oil from the tabernacle,
Et ascendit universa multitudo post eum,
And the entire multitude ascended after him.
And the people were playing on pipes,
et insonuit terra a clamore eorum.
And the earth resounded before the noise of them.
et omnes qui invitati fuerant ab eo:
and all who had been summoned by him, heard it.
And now the feast had ended. Then, too,
sed et Joab, audita voce tubæ,
Joab, hearing the voice of the trumpet,
Quid sibi vult clamor civitatis tumultuantis?
“What is the meaning of this clamor from the tumultuous city?”
Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, arrived.
for you are a valiant man,
dominus enim noster rex David regem constituit Salomonem:
For our lord king David has appointed Solomon as king.
And he has sent with him Zadok, the priest,
and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada,
et imposuerunt eum super mulam regis.
And they have placed him on the mule of the king.
Unxeruntque eum Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta regem in Gihon: et ascenderunt inde lætantes, et insonuit civitas: hæc est vox quam audistis.
And Zadok, the priest, and Nathan, the prophet, have anointed him king, at Gihon. And they are ascending from there, rejoicing, and so the city resounds. This is the noise that you have heard.
et Salomon sedet super solium regni.
Solomon sits upon the throne of the kingdom.
Et ingressi servi regis benedixerunt domino nostro regi David,
And the servants of the king, entering, have blessed our lord king David,
Amplificet Deus nomen Salomonis super nomen tuum,
‘May God amplify the name of Solomon above your name,
et magnificet thronus ejus super thronum tuum.
and may he magnify his throne above your throne.’
Et adoravit rex in lectulo suo:
And the king reverenced from his bed.
‘Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel,
qui dedit hodie sedentem in solio meo,
who today has bestowed someone to sit upon my throne,
while my eyes may see it.’”
Territi sunt ergo, et surrexerunt omnes qui invitati fuerant ab Adonia,
Therefore, all those who had been summoned by Adonijah were terrified.
et ivit unusquisque in viam suam.
And they all rose up, and each one went his own way.
And he took hold of the horn of the altar.
And they reported to Solomon, saying:
Ecce Adonias timens regem Salomonem, tenuit cornu altaris,
fearing king Solomon, has taken hold of the horn of the altar,
Juret mihi rex Salomon hodie, quod non interficiat servum suum gladio.
‘May king Solomon swear to me this day that he will not put to death his servant with the sword.’”
non cadet ne unus quidem capillus ejus in terram:
not so much as one hair of his head shall fall to the ground.
sin autem malum inventum fuerit in eo,
But if evil is found in him,
Misit ergo rex Salomon, et eduxit eum ab altari:
Therefore, king Solomon sent and brought him from the altar.
And entering, he reverenced king Solomon.
